text: PSI-BLAST uses a single fixed BLOSUM62 matrix throughout all search iterations and never updates its scoring based on prior results.
explanation: False. PSI-BLAST builds a position-specific scoring matrix (PSSM) from the results of an initial search and then iteratively re-searches the database with the updated PSSM, which is precisely what allows it to detect distantly related, remote homologs that a single fixed matrix would miss.
